newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan says will sell shares in affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Nissan says will sell shares in affiliate.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to sell 3.67 million shares, or a 30 percent stake, of Tosok Corp to Nippon Densan Corp for about two billion yen.
Nissan now owns 49 percent of Tosok, which makes automobile parts, such as power-steering and automatic transmission components.
Nippon Densan is a major Japanese maker of motors for use in computer hard disc drives.
The sale date will be at the end of March, a Nissan spokesman said.
Nippon Densan hopes to take advantage of Tosok's high technology, while Tosok will be able to expand its non-automobile business, the spokesman said.
